design: Primary 40-case coding was frozen before a fresh skeptical DeepSeek context coded 12 locked Deep Anchors against exact S1-S10. Independent prompt explicitly prohibited generic S1/S4 analogy and distinguished guardrail violation from claim contradiction.

s1Audit.independentReason: The case directly compares physical production systems and outcome records; it does not require a proxy/model/metric being silently collapsed into realized state.
s1Audit.finding: Primary S1=40/40 was over-coded. Reality/Representation separation remains strongly recurring, but it is not directly applicable to every historical improvement trajectory. A law can be foundational without every case instantiating its failure mode.

s3Audit.finding: This is primarily scope semantics, not applicability disagreement. Primary treats scoped local success (Pearl Street, automobile routes, Ford) as evidence that the literal frozen must-generalize wording needs an applicability qualifier. Independent treats explicit boundary-aware testing as support. HD3 retains the narrowing because the frozen text lacks the declared-scope qualifier established in prior waves.

rawContradiction.reason: Independent coder argued one fixed moving-flow method won within the mass-production world.

s4Audit.reason: S4 says useful method depends on current evidence/problem/world conditions; it does not require method switching inside a fixed world. Ford is explicitly conditional on standardized high-volume production and does not claim flow is globally optimal. A fixed method winning inside one regime is compatible with a conditional policy across regimes.
s4Audit.effect: Raw output remains unchanged; adjudicated direct contradictions remain zero.

findings: HD3 independent exact agreement is 84/120 = 70.0%; coarse applicability agreement is 102/120 = 85.0%, the strongest of HD1-HD3 so far but still far from a stable exact taxonomy.
S1 ceiling is legitimately broken by A12 NOT_APPLICABLE, demonstrating primary overcoding rather than a theory failure.
S4 raw contradiction is rejected as a quantifier/scope coding error; one fixed method can be conditionally optimal inside one world without becoming a global fixed operator.
S3 has perfect coarse agreement but poor exact SUPPORTS-vs-NARROWS agreement (5/12 exact), confirming that applicability-scope language remains underspecified in the frozen claim.

S5 remains highly elastic: only 2/12 exact and 4/12 coarse agreement. Physical/institutional structure invites metaphorical persistent-state mapping unless direct provenance/constraint storage is required.

No adjudicated direct contradiction is established after three waves. This keeps the campaign falsifiability pressure active; later waves need claims with stronger negation conditions rather than simply more anti-cases.
campaignMeasurementUpdate: The most important HD3 measurement correction is that recurrent semantic laws need not be applicable to every trajectory. Non-applicability is compatible with foundational importance; forcing a law into all cases creates false convergence.
